map.→ 打开遮阳系数计算工具: -> Open the shading coefficient calculator tool
map.会。南向水平板夏季挡高角烈日、冬季放低角暖阳，设计得当可兼顾；东/西向低角度日晒: Yes. A south-facing horizontal overhang blocks the high summer sun and admits low winter sun, so a good design serves both; low-angle morning or afternoon sun on east/west facades needs an adjustable angle or a movable shading device.
map.冬季会不会挡阳光？: Will it block sunlight in winter?
map.南向大窗加水平遮阳板，按板宽与窗高的几何关系估算遮阳系数，判断夏季得热削减效果。: A large south-facing window with a horizontal overhang: estimate the shading coefficient from the geometry of board width and window height, then judge how much summer heat gain is cut.
map.外遮阳和内遮阳差别大吗？: Do external and internal shading differ greatly?
map.对比无遮阳、内帘、外百叶三种方案的 SC，结合空调负荷做性价比取舍。: Compare the SC of the three schemes of no shading, inner curtain and external louvre, and weigh cost against the air-conditioning load.
map.很大。热量进入室内前被外遮阳挡住效率最高；内帘是热量已进屋再反射，降温效果弱得多: Very much so. External shading blocks the heat before it enters, so it is the most efficient; an inner curtain reflects heat after it is already indoors, so the cooling effect is far weaker.
map.节能审查前粗核外窗综合遮阳系数（窗 SC × 外遮阳系数），看是否达标。: Before an energy audit, roughly check the overall shading coefficient of the exterior window (window SC × external shading factor) to see whether it meets the target.
map.输入窗户朝向、太阳高度角与水平遮阳板尺寸，估算外遮阳系数与遮挡效率，用于建筑节能: Enter window orientation, solar altitude angle and horizontal overhang dimensions to estimate the external shading coefficient and shading efficiency, for building energy efficiency and shading design.
map.遮阳系数 1 表示无遮挡（或标准玻璃）下的全部得热；SC 越小遮挡越好，0.3: A shading coefficient of 1 means the full heat gain with no obstruction (or standard glass); the smaller the SC the better the shading, so 0.3 blocks far more heat than 0.8.
map.：窗高 1.5m，挑出遮阳板 0.6m，夏至正午高度角约 82°\n遮挡投影比:
: window height 1.5m, overhang projection 0.6m, summer solstice noon altitude about 82°
obstruction projection ratio 0.6/1.5=0.4 → blocks low-angle incidence, weak at noon
overall SC about 0.5–0.7 (depending on construction)
